pages.text: $(item)Atrium$() is mined from atrium ore and is the power source behind most Gallifreyan devices.$(br2)Charged with redstone around an iron core it becomes $(item)Energised Atrium$(), and the two together make an $(item)Atrium Core$().
Atrium wrapped around coal makes $(item)Atrium Fuel$(), which burns far longer than coal in any furnace.
